problem_type: generated user-visible verification text ignored the active locale
symptom: The English UI could show Chinese shot-verification reasons because the judge generated free-form reason text from a Chinese rubric and the result was displayed verbatim.
direct_cause: The renderer and Electron shot-verification orchestration paths built the same locale-agnostic judge prompt and did not pass the current application or desktop locale into the pure verification core.
class_root: User-visible text produced by a model had no explicit output-language contract at the shared prompt boundary, and the Electron-free locale state was not available to both verification runtimes.
affected_population: English UI users receiving shot-verification deviations in the canvas
English UI users receiving verification results through the Electron capability runtime
Any future caller of either mirrored shot-verification core that omits the reason-language context
entry_points: makeShotVerifyDeps and runShotVerification Electron capability orchestration
ReconcileDeviationCard display of generated and deterministic fallback reasons
internal_only_reason: Nomi owns the supported locales, verification prompt, dual runtime wiring, and display behavior. External model documentation cannot decide which language Nomi must request for user-visible reasons.
invariants: The active renderer locale is passed to the renderer verification core for every judged shot.
The active Electron desktop locale is held in one Electron-free module and passed to the capability verification core for every judged shot.
English verification prompts explicitly require an English reason while score keys and the calibrated rubric remain unchanged.
Chinese and omitted locale contexts produce byte-identical historical prompts.
The renderer and Electron verification cores remain byte-equivalent for every locale and frame mode.
Deterministic dimension names, tier values, and fallback reasons are translated at the ReconcileDeviationCard display boundary.
generality_proof: Both production orchestration paths now inject their authoritative locale before converging on the mirrored buildShotVerifyPrompt boundary. The equivalence suite covers English, Chinese, omitted locale, and video frame-pair combinations, while separate runner and dependency tests prove the renderer and Electron wiring cannot silently omit locale context.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own normalized desktop locale state without importing Electron so capability-runtime wiring can read it safely.
Apply the explicit reason-language instruction while preserving the calibrated scoring rubric and deterministic JSON shape.
Mirror the Electron core contract for renderer-originated verification and remain byte-equivalent under tests.
Translate deterministic verification labels and fallbacks while preserving arbitrary user/model text.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: toContext reads getAppLocale and the runner regression test observes the English instruction in the actual judge prompt.
The dependency factory reads getDesktopLocale and a focused test proves English is exposed to orchestration.
Every judge call converts a shot with deps.reasonLanguage before invoking the shared core prompt builder.
Stable dimension and fallback formats are reconstructed through i18n; free-form judge reasons remain the language requested upstream.

recurrence.reason: Every new verification caller or mirrored-core edit can omit locale context, and model-generated free-form text will otherwise inherit the rubric language rather than the user's interface language.
same_class_scan: Searched renderer and Electron capability paths for buildShotVerifyPrompt, reasonLanguage, verdict.reason, and deviation.reason consumers.
Checked the renderer runner and Electron dependency/orchestration paths independently rather than relying only on pure-core tests.
Checked deterministic fallback reasons separately from arbitrary model-generated reasons at the display boundary.

prevention.invariant: Every English verification context adds one explicit English-reason instruction without changing score semantics or the Chinese default prompt.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported or omitted locale values retain the established Chinese default; focused wiring and byte-equivalence tests fail if either production path or mirrored core drifts.
prevention.strategy: Centralize desktop locale state outside Electron imports, inject locale at both orchestration boundaries, enforce output language in the pure prompt builders, and translate only deterministic fallback strings at render time.

legacy_paths.rationale: Both current verification runtimes remain supported and now share the explicit locale contract; no fallback implementation or legacy route is retained.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The failure is in Nomi-owned locale propagation and prompt construction, not in a third-party model SDK or i18n dependency version.

migration: No persisted state or protocol migration is required. The locale is process state, reasonLanguage is optional for backward-compatible callers, and omitted values preserve the previous Chinese prompt byte-for-byte.
residual_risks: An upstream judge model can still disobey an explicit output-language instruction; arbitrary free-form reasons cannot be safely machine-translated without changing meaning.
Verification skip and transport-error reasons are separate deterministic runtime strings and require their own translation keys when exposed by a future English flow.
